notablePrerequisites:
Illusionist's Bracers attached to Kwain.
Kwain and Palladium Myr do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Palladium Myr by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Kwain by tapping it.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Kwain's ability.
Resolve the copy of Kwain's ability, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life, and allowing your opponent to draw a card and gain 1 life.
Tolarian Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to untap Palladium Myr.
Resolve Kwain's ability, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life, and allowing your opponent to draw a card and gain 1 life.
Tolarian Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to untap Kwain.
Repeat.
